local_terms.meaning: A finite or explicitly bounded set of typed work definitions connected by declared structural release conditions and presented as one reusable work boundary.
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not recursive execution authority, a scheduler tree, domain approval, or proof of termination.

local_terms.meaning: An immutable, versioned description of one typed unit of work, its contracts, body, authority requirements, and explicit limits.
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not a mutable run, an attempt, a permission grant, or an implementation.

local_terms.meaning: A versioned structural composition of work nodes and event-triggered edges with explicit input mappings and bounds.
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not communication permission, runtime state, domain truth, or an independently authored replacement for DomainSpec source.

local_terms.meaning: One invocation of an exact work definition under one stable root identity and authority basis.
local_terms.owner_route: Future CyberAlchemy v2 work-orchestration runtime owner
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not the work definition, child scheduler, attempt, or global domain status.

local_terms.meaning: An ordered, append-only sequence of accepted structural events used as replay input while preserving work-owned domain state separately.
local_terms.owner_route: Future journal owner plus each work-domain owner
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not automatically authoritative domain state, effect success, or artifact admission.

local_terms.meaning: A rebuildable structural projection of satisfied edges, enabled nodes, and delivered commands for one root work run.
local_terms.owner_route: Future CyberAlchemy v2 work-orchestration runtime owner
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not an authoritative leaf status, approval, permission, or domain projection.

local_terms.meaning: A typed boundary that receives addressed commands, invokes one external or local work mechanism, and reports accepted events without transferring domain authority to orchestration.
local_terms.owner_route: Future selected realization owner plus the bound work owner
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: Not an implicit credential, effect authorization, agent selection policy, or evidence of successful execution.

local_terms.meaning: A work-owned decision boundary that emits one declared route result while retaining the meaning and evidence of that decision outside structural orchestration.
local_terms.forbidden_collapse: A route label is not the semantic verdict, authority grant, or downstream effect permission.
